name: cuban-cards-components
description: Componentes React y Vue para identificar tarjetas cubanas con el catálogo abierto cuban_cards_prefixes.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cuban-cards/react && npm run build --workspace @cuban-cards/vue
scripts.build:examples: npm run build --workspace @cuban-cards/example-react && npm run build --workspace @cuban-cards/example-vue
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run build:examples
